question: Should ACP numeric runtime timeout patches preserve the existing rounding behavior, or should OpenClaw intentionally make this API integer-only?
rationale: Current main normalizes finite numeric values by rounding, while the PR converts the same previously accepted inputs into errors; source evidence does not establish that an unannounced compatibility break is desired.

options.title: Retain numeric rounding
options.body: Preserve the current ACP caller contract and close the strict-rejection proposal unless a separately approved API change is desired.

options.title: Adopt integer-only ACP timeouts
options.body: Approve the compatibility change, specify the upgrade contract, and require a rebase that adds the fractional cases to the current runtime-options suite.

recommendation.title: Retain numeric rounding
recommendation.body: Preserve the current ACP caller contract and close the strict-rejection proposal unless a separately approved API change is desired.

likelyOwner.reason: Recently merged adjacent work on the same ACP runtime-options owner boundary and test suite.
